# SUBTITLE

Put a subtitle in the output, above the output that follows.

## Syntax

```text
SUBTITLE [']text['].
```

As TITLE, for a second heading. A blank subtitle (' ') shows nothing.

## Example

```text
SUBTITLE "Children's shoes only".
```

`statscraft help SUBTITLE` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
